provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Solar Farm

examples.psychological_goal: 一句假设把观众的拥有幻想变成共同语境
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称幻想式开场（so you want to own a X）
examples.example_text: So, you want to own a solar power plant.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"所以你想拥有一座X"直接开局，零铺垫进入主题
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体资产对象

examples.psychological_goal: 把"被动收入"幻想讲到最顺，为反转蓄力
examples.expression_mechanism: 极简画面+时间状语的躺赚意象（turning into money while you sleep）
examples.example_text: Just sunlight turning into money while you sleep.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用一句话把好处讲到最顺，再亲手打破它

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话立起全片主悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: 双事实落差定位（the gap between these two facts is where fortunes are made and lost）
examples.example_text: the gap between these two facts is where fortunes are made and lost.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"两个事实之间的落差"定义故事发生的地方

examples.psychological_goal: 用定义问题重置观众坐标，开启正文章回
examples.expression_mechanism: 定义重置句（let's start with what X actually is）
examples.example_text: Let's start with what a solar farm actually is
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在hook之后用"先定义我们在谈什么"稳住节奏
examples.negative_instruction: 定义后必须给出可用的区分标准

examples.psychological_goal: 用负电价机制制造首次反直觉冲击
examples.expression_mechanism: 责任倒置表达（has to pay the grid to take its energy）
examples.example_text: means that the solar plant has to pay the grid to take its energy
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"倒贴钱请对方收货"式倒置揭示市场反常

examples.psychological_goal: 为成本章节预设"冲击"预期
examples.expression_mechanism: 冲击预告句（the first shock is always the price tag）
examples.example_text: business. The first shock is always the price tag even before construction begins. In the
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"第一个冲击总是X"开启算账章节
examples.negative_instruction: 冲击预告后必须立刻给出数字

examples.psychological_goal: 把巨额投入与零产出并置，制造资本黑洞节拍
examples.expression_mechanism: 投入-产出对置（spent $90-130 million, but not a single watt produced yet）
examples.example_text: So you spent between $90 million and $130 million . But not a single watt of energy has been produced yet .
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"钱花完了，产品还没影"的节拍强调前置成本

examples.psychological_goal: 用反直觉前提开启融资章
examples.expression_mechanism: 反直觉声明+即时解释（sell electricity even before the plant is built）
examples.example_text: the developer needs to do something counterintuitive. They need to sell electricity even before the plant is built.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"在X之前必须先做Y"的反直觉操作勾住注意力
examples.negative_instruction: 声明后必须解释为什么

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示政策依赖的结构性风险
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连枚举+结果（one policy change, one budget decision, one change in administration—and an entire layer unprofitable）
examples.example_text: trap lies. One policy change, one unfavorable budget decision, one change in administration—and an entire layer of the project's economy can become unprofitable.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用三个"一"排比表现系统的脆弱性
examples.negative_instruction: 保持结构性中性，不做政策立场表达

examples.psychological_goal: 从乐观模型硬切到风险章，完成情绪反转
examples.expression_mechanism: 肯定-反转急转（the math looks good. now let's talk about what's actually going wrong）
examples.example_text: The math looks good. Now let's talk about what's actually going wrong.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"账看起来不错。现在说说哪里会出错"完成情绪换挡
examples.negative_instruction: 换挡后必须交付足够的威胁证据

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示行业结构性自毁机制，完成全片最强认知反转
examples.expression_mechanism: 结构悖论判词（destroy their own economy the more they become）
examples.example_text: prices. Solar farms, in a structural sense, destroy their own economy the more
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"越多越伤害自己"的结构性悖论重构观众理解
examples.negative_instruction: 判词后必须给机制解释与证据

examples.psychological_goal: 用单项成本除法演示规模经济
examples.expression_mechanism: 除法对比量化（20 to 1 difference on just one expense item）
examples.example_text: That's a 20 to 1 difference on just one expense item.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"同一固定成本÷不同规模"的除法演示规模优势

examples.psychological_goal: 用燃料成本对照解释机构为何偏爱该资产
examples.expression_mechanism: 跨行业成本结构对照（unlike a gas plant: no fuel costs, fixed and predictable）
examples.example_text: natural gas power plant, a solar farm has no fuel costs, making its operating cost structure almost entirely fixed and predictable.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"与相邻行业差一个成本变量"解释资产吸引力

examples.psychological_goal: 用设问把全片问题收敛为一句裁决承诺
examples.expression_mechanism: 俗称设问+诚实答案承诺（a "gold mine"? here's an honest answer with real numbers）
examples.example_text: more valuable over time. So, is the solar station a " gold mine"? Here's an honest answer with real numbers
examples.usage_instruction: 学习借大众俗称设问，再承诺用数字诚实回答
examples.negative_instruction: 承诺后必须给出完整的双情景数字

examples.psychological_goal: 把双情景差异升华为可迁移的判断
examples.expression_mechanism: 排比累积判词（a little less sun, a little more expenses, a little worse refinancing）
examples.example_text: single factor. This is an accumulation of small deviations. A little less sun, a little more expenses, a little worse refinancing
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"a little"排比表现"小偏差累积"的杀伤力

examples.psychological_goal: 破除"印钞机"迷思，给出条件式真相
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定-肯定重构（don't print money; they convert X into Y, but only when...）
examples.example_text: analysis. Solar farms don't print money. They convert sunlight into long-term, predictable cash flows, but only when
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"不是X，是只在条件对齐时才成立的Y"收束判断
examples.negative_instruction: 条件清单必须来自正文已拆解的变量

examples.psychological_goal: 回call开场判词，完成首尾闭环
examples.expression_mechanism: 让步-转折格言（the sun may be free, but everything that turns it into a dollar costs something）
examples.example_text: The sun may be free, but everything that turns that sunlight into a dollar in your account costs something. And understanding
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X也许免费，但把X变成钱的每一步都有成本"的让步式格言

examples.psychological_goal: 把全片压缩成投资者分野的一句话
examples.expression_mechanism: 人群二分收束（the main difference between investors who make a fortune and those who lose it）
examples.example_text: main difference between investors who make a fortune and those who lose it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"赚钱者与亏钱者的主要差别"把知识变成身份分野
